lines.text: Old Jonas lives in an upturned boat on the quay: a stove, a lamp, and a smell of tar and warm bread.
Pip stands dripping on the floor, out of breath, with Ruby's instrument case in both arms.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: You must be the trumpeter. I heard the whistles from here. Sit down before you fall down.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Um. Ruby said to find you. She gave me this.
He sets the case on the table. Jonas runs a thumb over the brass latches and says nothing for a long moment.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: Her horn. Thirty years she never let anyone else carry it. She trusted it to a kid in the middle of a raid.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [A kid. Fine. A kid with very sore arms.]

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: A fish cart took Ruby over the back wall before the Squad finished the stairs. She'll come for that case. She always does.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: She's Ruby. The Cellar is gone, though. The chairs, the piano, the stage. The Squad took the lot.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: Whoever signs these orders wants this town quiet. I would like to know why.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Me too. Um. What do we do now?

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: We find the ones who are still loud. There's a drummer boy down by the docks. Teun. Loudest kid in Port Murmur, and he can't hide to save his life.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [I can't hide either. Maybe two bad hiders add up to one decent one.]
Outside, the rain keeps falling. Somewhere along the docks a drum starts up, very softly, and then not so softly.
